name: shared-axis-z
title: Shared Axis Z
description: A depth swap between two phrases: the old one scales up, blurs and fades away while the new one rises from a smaller scale and sharpens into focus, like a camera push forward.
useWhen: Moving from a broad idea to a more specific or deeper one: a zoom-in narrative.
Chaining topic shifts where each swap should feel like a camera push forward.
avoidWhen: The swap is a lateral topic change with no depth: use shared-axis-y.
The text only needs to come in, with nothing going out: use scale-down-fade or soft-blur-in.
The scene already has a lot of scale motion: alternate with shared-axis-y.
author: Remocn

variables.label: From text
variables.description: Outgoing phrase; it scales up and fades away.

variables.label: To text
variables.description: Incoming phrase; it rises from a smaller scale into focus.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum text size in pixels. Longer text shrinks to fit the frame.
